answer:
I don't know. The retrieved documents don't give any throughput figure for `IngestionPipeline`, such as documents per second on a single CPU core. Throughput would depend on the transformations used (splitters, extractors, embedding models) and the hardware.

The only related line is about parallelism, not speed:

"The `run` method of `IngestionPipeline` can be executed with parallel processes." [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/loading/ingestion_pipeline/index.md]

It says you can set `num_workers` to spread batches of nodes across processes, but it gives no benchmark. To get a real number, you'd need to time your own pipeline on your own data.
